title: Gamepad input
summary: Samples generic namespaced actions from standard gamepad buttons and axes; retains editable flight mappings and diagnostics.

blocks.text: Samples generic namespaced actions from standard gamepad buttons and axes; retains editable flight mappings and diagnostics.
Capabilities: input.gamepad@1.0.0; no required or optional services. Constructors receive active actions, mappings and per-seat pad assignment.
Environment: browser and offline. Platform authority; excluded from authoritative simulation identity. Public API and local source only.

Generic sources have no persistence. Flight compatibility reads space-sim:gamepad:v1 and migrates existing profiles. Disconnect/reassignment suppress held input until neutral. Factory disposal releases sources/managers and disconnect listeners.

Unpack, edit source, rebuild and repack. Explicitly enable trusted code in a compatible game; imported code has full application privileges. Package-building success alone does not establish game/runtime portability.
